title: Professor Lund's Greenhouse
teaser: A flower that never blooms in these parts came into bloom in Professor Lund's greenhouse, and the professor promised to explain where it came from. Now Lund lies among the orchids, and the leaves are dusted with a rare pollen. One person brought the poison, and another led the professor to the flower.

habits.label: Soil under the nails
clues: The professor's white coat has black finger marks of rich soil on it, and the soil in the tropical house is red. The culprit has soil under their nails.
There are black crumbs of soil on the handle of the professor's study door, as if it had been touched with unwashed fingers. The culprit has black soil under their nails.

habits.label: Magnifying glass on a cord
habits.habit: A pocket magnifying glass on a cord
clues: The brass rim of a magnifying glass with a bit of cord lies on a bench in the tropical house. The culprit carries a magnifying glass on a cord.
Five minutes before 10:30 someone was seen at the entrance to the tropical house examining pollen through a glass on a cord. The culprit carries a magnifying glass on a cord.

habits.label: Latin names
habits.habit: Knows the Latin names of plants
clues: The full Latin name has been written by hand on the label next to the rare flower, without a mistake. The culprit knows the Latin names of plants.
The note that called the professor to the tropical house gives the flower's name in Latin, the way only botanists write. The culprit knows the Latin names of plants.

habits.label: Cardamom coffee
clues: A cup from the garden café stands on a bench in the tropical house, cardamom seeds in the grounds at the bottom. The culprit drinks coffee with cardamom.
The garden café made exactly one cup with cardamom this morning, and it was carried off towards the tropical house. The culprit drinks coffee with cardamom.

habits.label: Thorn scratches
clues: There's blood and a scrap of skin on the bougainvillea thorns at the entrance to the tropical house. The culprit's hands are scratched by thorns.
The professor's sleeve has thin streaks of someone else's blood, like fresh scratches. The culprit's hands are scratched by thorns.

habits.label: Tweed jacket
habits.habit: A tweed jacket with leather elbow patches
clues: Brown tweed threads are caught on a rivet of a bench in the tropical house. The culprit wears a tweed jacket.
An elbow with the neat oval of a leather patch has left its print on a damp bench. The culprit's jacket has elbow patches.

habits.label: Sketches from life
clues: Behind the palm tub there's a pencil sketch of that very flower, made this morning. The culprit sketches from life.
There are pencil shavings and eraser crumbs on the windowsill of the tropical house. The culprit draws plants from life.

habits.label: Catches butterflies
clues: A matchbox with a swallowtail butterfly inside lies on the path in the tropical house. The culprit collects butterflies.
The top twigs of the bush by the body are broken, with green threads from a net's gauze on them. The culprit catches butterflies.

habits.label: Smells of wax
clues: The handle of the tropical house door has a yellow film on it that smells of beeswax. The culprit smells of wax.
There are crumbs of wax with a honey smell on the leaves near the flower. The culprit smells of beeswax.

habits.label: Wooden clogs
clues: The wet path in the tropical house has deep prints of wooden soles with a row of little nails. The culprit wears wooden clogs.
At about 10:20 people in the garden café heard wooden soles clattering on the flagstones of the avenue. The culprit wears wooden clogs.

habits.label: Birthmark
habits.habit: A port-wine birthmark on the neck
clues: Someone with a port-wine birthmark on their neck was seen at the entrance to the tropical house. The culprit has a birthmark on their neck.
A photo of a tour group taken at 10:15 shows the back of a head with a birthmark by the orchid tubs. The culprit has a birthmark on their neck.

habits.label: Seed packets
clues: A paper packet of tiny black seeds, labelled by hand, lies under a bench. The culprit carries seeds in packets.
The pocket of the professor's coat holds someone else's packet of seeds, folded into a special little envelope. The culprit always carries packets of seeds.

habits.label: Tropical tan
habits.habit: A tan from a tropical expedition
clues: From the café someone saw a person by the tropical house with a deep tan you never get in this climate. The culprit has a tropical tan.
The note to the professor says: "You'll know me by my tan, I've just come back from Java." The culprit has a tropical tan.

habits.label: Pocket thermometer
habits.habit: A pocket thermometer in a case
clues: The tropical house's wall thermometer hangs in its place, and there's a second one, a pocket thermometer in a brass case, on a bench. The culprit carries a pocket thermometer.
A pocket thermometer is stuck in the orchid tub; someone measured the soil right by the flower. The culprit carries a pocket thermometer.

habits.label: Feeds the birds
habits.habit: Keeps crumbs in their pockets for the birds
clues: Breadcrumbs are scattered on the path in the tropical house, and sparrows are flitting over them. The culprit keeps crumbs in their pocket for the birds.
There's a heap of crumbs and pigeon footprints on the windowsill of the professor's study. The culprit feeds the birds.

habits.label: Rubberised cape
habits.habit: A rubberised cape with a hood
clues: A torn scrap of rubberised cloth hangs on a hook by the tropical house door. The culprit wears a rubberised cape.
There's a hem-shaped puddle on the floor of the professor's study, where water ran off a waterproof cape. The culprit wears a rubberised cape.

tools: A glass panel of the tropical house was taken out of its frame and put back, the putty trimmed with a knife. The culprit is handy with tools.
The watering valve in the tropical house was unscrewed with an adjustable spanner and tightened again. The culprit is handy with tools.
strong: A heavy palm tub was moved to block the way to the body. The culprit is physically strong.
The professor was carried from the door deep into the tropical house, right up to the flower. The culprit is physically strong.
medic: The pollen on the leaves is mixed with a powder that works through the skin within minutes. The culprit knows about poisons.
The professor's cup contains poison in a dose measured to the milligram. The culprit knows about poisons.
glasses: A round lens from a pair of glasses is stuck in the orchid leaves. The culprit wears glasses.
There's the imprint of a glasses frame on the misted glass of the tropical house. The culprit wears glasses.
quiet: The parrots in the tropical house screech at every step, yet this morning they were silent. The culprit moves silently.
The gravel on the path crunches loudly, but the gardeners at the entrance heard nothing. The culprit moves silently.
keys: The tropical house is closed to visitors until 11:00, and the lock was opened with a key. The culprit had keys.
The reagent cabinet in the lab was unlocked and locked again without a single scratch. The culprit had keys.
cash: The money raised to buy that very flower is missing from the garden's cash box. The culprit had access to money.
A bill for rare bulbs was paid from the cash box, and the professor's signature is forged. The culprit had access to money.
safe: The safe in the professor's study was opened without force, and the expedition diary is gone. The culprit knows the safe combination.
The professor kept the safe combination in his head, yet the door was opened neatly and the papers rearranged. The culprit knows the safe combination.
tech: The electric heating in the tropical house was switched off at the fuse board, and the glass misted up so that nothing can be seen from outside. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
The watering pump was switched to mist, and the tropical house filled with steam. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
french: The card next to the rare flower has a note in French: "Pour le professeur". The culprit knows French.
Shortly before 10:30 a conversation in French was heard from the tropical house. The culprit knows French.
perfume: Among the scents of the orchids, a heavy perfume stands out clearly. The culprit wears heavy perfume.
The smell of a thick perfume lingers on the professor's collar. The culprit wears heavy perfume.
lefty: The stems by the flower were cut at an angle that only a left hand produces. The culprit is left-handed.
The note to the professor slants to the left and is smudged by the edge of a left palm. The culprit is left-handed.
whistle: Five minutes before 10:30 someone was heard whistling a waltz in the tropical house. The culprit whistles.
The parrot in the tropical house keeps repeating a new tune someone whistled next to its cage. The culprit whistles.
driver: There are fresh van tracks at the service gate, though there were no deliveries today. The culprit can drive.
The garden's van isn't where it was left last night, and the engine is still warm. The culprit can drive.
late: The lamp in the lab burned all night, next to a cold, half-drunk cup of tea. The culprit is a night owl.
The watchman's log notes a light in the lab at three in the morning. The culprit doesn't sleep at night.
